### Step 1 — Scene
A mixed meal of Caesar-style salad, cooked broccoli, breaded chicken strips, and a small piece of cheese pizza or cheesy flatbread.

### Step 2 — Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **27–28 cm across**. Using a 28 cm circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 14² ≈ 615 cm².**

### Steps 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Dressing, croutons, and cheese are estimated separately from the lettuce. Their areas represent portions of the salad’s visible footprint, not additional overlapping coverage.

| Visible item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Romaine lettuce | 27% | 166 cm² × 3 cm = 498 ml | 0.15 | 75 g | 17 | 13 kcal |
| Croutons | 3% | 18 cm² × 1.8 cm = 33 ml | 0.30 | 10 g | 410 | 41 kcal |
| Parmesan shavings | 1% | 6 cm² × 0.4 cm = 2.4 ml | 1.0 | 2 g | 420 | 8 kcal |
| Creamy salad dressing | 2% | 12 cm² × 0.8 cm = 10 ml | 1.0 | 10 g | 480 | 48 kcal |
| Breaded chicken strips | 15% | 92 cm² × 1.3 cm = 120 ml | 0.95 | 114 g | 260 | 296 kcal |
| Cooked broccoli | 12% | 74 cm² × 2 cm = 148 ml | 0.60 | 89 g | 35 | 31 kcal |
| Cheese pizza/flatbread piece | 10% | 62 cm² × 1 cm = 62 ml | 0.95 | 59 g | 280 | 165 kcal |

### Step 8 — Sanity check
The areas total **70% plate coverage**, consistent with the substantial empty section on the right. Estimated total: **359 g and 602 kcal**. The biggest uncertainties are the chicken’s breading and preparation, dressing quantity, and the partially cropped pizza piece. No separate oil is clearly visible.
